newsitem.title: USA: Tele-Communications Intl names Evans president.
newsitem.headline: Tele-Communications Intl names Evans president.

text.p: Tele-Communications Intl Inc, a unit of Tele-Communications Inc, said Monday it has appointed David Evans as president and chief operating officer, effective September 1.

It said Evans, who is joining the company from News Corp where he has been executive vice president since July 1996, will perform both functions until sometime in 1998, when he will assume the role of chief executive officer.
Fred Vierra, the current CEO, will remain vice chairman for an indefinite period, it said.

Evans also served as president and CEO of Sky Entertainment Services Latin America Inc, in which Tele-Communications International is a partner. Evans will continue to serve on the board of Grupo Televisa SA Telecommunications International said.
Evans was also previously president and chief operating officer of Fox Television, a News Corp unit. Before that, he was president for international operations of British Sky Broadcasting.
Evans said his association with Rupert Murdoch and News Corp, which Murdoch controls, "has been richly rewarding professional expericne and I leave on the very best of terms."

"The opportunity to work with Fred Vierra and his colleagues in building Telecommunications International for the future is an exceptional one and represents a new and exciting dimension to my career."

Tele-Communications International operates broadband cable television and telephony distribution networks. It also provides diversified programming services. Its parent Tele-Communications Inc is a leading U.S. cable operator.
